note: Single-pass extraction by Claude reading the paper text; evidence references sections/figures/tables. No multi-run validation.

components.description: Itemwise evaluation gap motivates the Q-sort value-structure framework, whose human reference, LLM geometries and alignment results are analyzed

nodes.name: Itemwise evaluations miss structure
nodes.description: Most LLM value evaluations are itemwise and behavioral, so they do not recover how a model organizes competing values as a whole; models that look similar itemwise may prioritize morals differently once trade-offs are unavoidable.

nodes.name: Symmetric Q-methodology protocol
nodes.description: Humans (N=35) and 12 LLMs from four families sort the same 140-item, theory-grounded (Schwartz, Moral Foundations) moral Q-set into a nine-column forced distribution; for LLMs strict full rankings are elicited and deterministically mapped to Q-sort buckets.

nodes.name: Human reference has three factors
nodes.description: By-person factor analysis (PCA plus Varimax) of the 35 human Q-sorts gives a stable three-factor solution: Empathic Protection (F1, 22 sorts), Civic Decency (F2, 8) and Liberty & Accountability (F3, 5).

nodes.name: Human reference is robust
nodes.description: Leave-one-out re-estimation gives very high factor stability (mean Spearman F1=0.997, F2=0.981, F3=0.950), so the structure is not driven by any single participant.

nodes.name: LLM geometry via PCA
nodes.description: For each LLM and temperature, an LLM item geometry is built by PCA over replicate-by-item bucket scores (n=10 replicates); conditions with rank below k=3 are flagged degenerate and geometry metrics left undefined.

nodes.name: Alignment metrics
nodes.description: Structural alignment with the human geometry is quantified by Procrustes similarity (phi) and RSA-based Spearman correlation (rho) between item-item distance matrices.

nodes.name: Stability varies widely
nodes.description: Qwen3-32B and Qwen3-8B are fully stable (r_stab=rho_stab=1.000), Gemini-2.5-Pro is highly stable (0.997 at T=0), but GPT-5.1 is much less stable (r_stab=0.473, rho_stab=0.484 at T=0).

nodes.name: Alignment differs by family and checkpoint
nodes.description: At T=0 DeepSeek-V3 has the highest Spearman rho (0.176, phi 0.371), GPT-5.1 the highest phi (0.372, rho 0.105), and Gemini-2.5-Flash/Pro are weakly aligned (rho -0.012/-0.033); model recency gives limited guidance.

nodes.name: Temperature effects non-monotonic
nodes.description: Raising temperature from 0 to 0.7 lowers DeepSeek-V3 alignment (phi 0.371 to 0.234) but raises DeepSeek-V3.1 (0.139 to 0.198) and GPT-3.5-Turbo (0.277 to 0.341).

nodes.name: Stability is not alignment
nodes.description: Gemini-2.5-Pro is extremely stable yet weakly aligned while GPT-5.1 is less stable but more aligned, so reliability and validity are distinct properties.

nodes.name: Region-wise misalignment
nodes.description: Alignment is heterogeneous across Schwartz regions: within one LLM some regions preserve human local trade-offs while others show weak or negative correspondence, so a single scalar can mask local mismatch.

nodes.name: Rank and bucket analyses agree
nodes.description: Across non-degenerate conditions rank-based and bucket-based results are strongly consistent (Spearman 0.855 for phi, 0.846 for rho), so results are not driven by rank-to-bucket post-processing.

nodes.name: Geometry exceeds profile similarity
nodes.description: The priority-profile baseline is weak (median rho_best=0.143, max 0.332) and tracks geometry scores only loosely, so the framework captures trade-off organization rather than average endorsement.

isolated_nodes.name: Few replicates suffice
isolated_nodes.description: Geometry estimates are fairly stable with fewer than ten runs: at n_rep=3 median SDs are 0.029 for phi and 0.026 for rho.

isolated_nodes.name: Prompt wording matters
isolated_nodes.description: For GPT-5.1 mean-profile Spearman correlation across prompt paraphrases is only 0.099 at T=0 and 0.302 at T=0.7, so wording remains consequential.

isolated_nodes.name: Degeneracy is a boundary condition
isolated_nodes.description: Undefined Procrustes/RSA scores in rank-collapsed conditions mean the structure is not estimable, not high or low alignment.

structural_reasoning: Itemwise-evaluation gap motivates the symmetric Q-sort protocol; human reference and LLM geometries feed the alignment metrics, which yield family-, temperature- and region-level findings plus robustness checks.
